description: Retrieval-in-the-loop corpus for the PARITY-RETRIEVAL-LOOP bench. Each system ingests these facts into its OWN store, then must RETRIEVE the needle fact(s) natively (no handed context) and GENERATE an answer from only what it retrieved. Content is deliberately GENERIC trivia — no TerranSoul/RAG/architecture domain seeds — so neither system has a built-in advantage (rules/bench-agi-purity.md AGI-purity). Facts and distractors are designed so each needle question has a single unambiguous gold fact and several near-miss distractors that share surface vocabulary, exercising real semantic retrieval rather than keyword lookup.

facts.text: The Aldervane Bridge in the town of Marrowfield was completed in 1887 and spans 412 meters across the Calloway River.
Cartographer Imelda Voss drew the first accurate map of the Sable Archipelago in 1623 using a borrowed astrolabe.
The recipe for Brennan's plum chutney calls for exactly seven cloves and a tablespoon of toasted fennel seed.
In the board game Hollowmere, a player who lands on a beacon tile may move any one opponent's token back three spaces.
The lighthouse at Pellam Point flashes a double white pulse every nine seconds during fog conditions.
Botanist Caro Niedling classified the violet-throated marsh orchid as Stipula caroli in her 1954 field journal.
The municipal archive in Drest keeps its rare-manuscript vault at a constant 18 degrees Celsius and 45 percent humidity.
Clockmaker Yusuf Adeyemi signed every piece he made after 1902 with a tiny engraved heron beneath the dial.
The annual Harrow Valley cheese fair awards its top prize, the Golden Curd, on the second Sunday of October.
The submarine cable named Tethys-4 carries data between the islands of Korsay and Velund along a 230-kilometer route.
In the constructed language Theldari, the word 'umbren' means a debt that can only be repaid by a song.
The dye known as Marrowfield blue is produced by fermenting the husks of the indigo-spotted snail for forty days.
Conductor Petra Halvorsen premiered the Sixth Symphony of composer Anders Bohl at the Lindqvist Hall in 1971.
The hiking trail to Cinder Tarn gains 940 meters of elevation over its 6.5-kilometer length and is rated difficult.
The Verity Press first edition of 'A Quiet Tally' had a printing error that turned page 88 entirely upside down.
Brewmaster Odette Falk ages her smoked porter in barrels that previously held maple syrup for eighteen months.
The observatory on Mount Sabal can resolve binary stars separated by as little as 0.3 arcseconds on clear nights.
The traditional Sable Archipelago greeting 'fenna soor' is offered only to travelers who arrive by boat after sunset.
Architect Lucan Brey designed the spiral staircase in the Drest archive so that it has exactly 121 steps.
The chess variant called Tideway is played on a 10-by-8 board and adds a piece named the otter that moves like a knight plus one diagonal.
The Calloway River freezes solid enough to walk across only when temperatures stay below minus twelve Celsius for nine straight days.
Perfumer Saoirse Lenk built her signature scent 'Ninefold' around bergamot, wet slate, and a trace of burnt sugar.
The Hollowmere rulebook fines a player two coins for moving out of turn, payable to the shared bank tile.
The radio station KQRX in the valley town of Drest broadcasts a live accordion hour every Thursday at 7 p.m.
Glassblower Tamsin Oyelaran invented a furnace damper that cut her studio's gas use by thirty-one percent.
The migratory route of the pale-banded tern crosses the Sable Archipelago between the autumn and spring equinoxes.
The municipal pool in Marrowfield is exactly 33.3 meters long, a quirk left over from an aborted Olympic bid in 1932.
Locksmith Bran Eko forged the seven master keys to the Drest archive, and only three remain unaccounted for.
The plum trees in Brennan's orchard are grafted onto blackthorn rootstock to survive the valley's late frosts.
The Tethys-4 cable was severed by a trawler anchor in 2009 and took eleven days to repair.
Composer Anders Bohl wrote his Sixth Symphony entirely in the key of D-flat major as a private tribute to his late teacher.
The Golden Curd trophy at the Harrow Valley cheese fair is cast from recycled brass church bells.
Mount Sabal's observatory dome rotates on a track of 96 cast-iron wheels installed in 1949.
In Theldari, plurals are formed by repeating the final syllable, so 'umbren' becomes 'umbrenren' for many debts.
The pale-banded tern lays exactly two eggs per season on the bare rock of Korsay's northern cliffs.
Odette Falk's brewery uses well water drawn from an aquifer 64 meters beneath the Harrow Valley floor.
The upside-down page 88 made the Verity Press first edition of 'A Quiet Tally' a collector's item worth over four thousand units.
The otter piece in Tideway may not capture on its first move of the game, a rule added in the 1998 ruleset revision.
Caro Niedling pressed and preserved over nine hundred orchid specimens, now housed in the Drest archive's botany wing.
The Aldervane Bridge was repainted in Marrowfield blue in 1991 to mark its hundredth-plus anniversary celebration.
The Aldervane Tunnel, unrelated to the bridge, was abandoned mid-construction in 1879 after a flood.
A different cartographer, Imelda Voss the younger, drew tourist maps of Harrow Valley in 1923, not the Sable Archipelago.
Brennan's apple chutney, a separate recipe, uses cinnamon and star anise instead of cloves and fennel.
In the board game Hollowmere, the beacon tile was originally called the lantern tile before the second edition.
The lighthouse at Pellam Cove, a different structure, was decommissioned in 1968 and now houses a cafe.
Botanist Caro Niedling also catalogued ferns, but her fern work was never formally published.
The municipal archive in Marrowfield, not Drest, keeps newspapers but has no climate-controlled vault.
Clockmaker Yusuf Adeyemi's earlier pieces, made before 1902, carried no maker's mark at all.
The Harrow Valley wine fair, distinct from the cheese fair, is held in the spring and awards no trophy.
The submarine cable Tethys-3, the predecessor to Tethys-4, ran a shorter route and was retired in 2004.
In Theldari, the word 'umbra' simply means shadow and has nothing to do with debt or song.
Marrowfield green, a cheaper dye than the blue, is made from common pond algae in just three days.
Conductor Petra Halvorsen also led the Fourth Symphony of a different composer, Mira Sten, in 1969.
The easy hiking trail to Cinder Meadow, not the tarn, is flat and only two kilometers long.
The Verity Press second edition of 'A Quiet Tally' corrected the page 88 error and is therefore far less valuable.
Brewmaster Odette Falk's pale ale, unlike her porter, is aged in stainless tanks for only three weeks.
The smaller observatory at Mount Halder, not Sabal, can only resolve binary stars wider than 1.2 arcseconds.
The Sable Archipelago farewell 'soor fenna' is the daytime equivalent and carries no boat requirement.
Architect Lucan Brey's earlier staircase in the Marrowfield town hall has 88 steps, not 121.
The chess variant Tidewater, a near-namesake of Tideway, is played on a standard 8-by-8 board with no extra pieces.

scoring_rubric.relevance: Does the answer directly address the question using the specific fact asked for?
scoring_rubric.accuracy: Does it match the gold answer, with no contradiction from a distractor fact and no invented detail?
scoring_rubric.completeness: Does it include every part the question asks for (e.g., both the number and the spice, or both places and the distance)?
